items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I remember doing a show in Cleveland, Ohio with Ethel Waters and Bill "Bojangles" Robinson at one of the RKO houses the, (inaudible) there. I was the band and they was, we was all three of us on the show together.

ctx.x: Right. Fats. Fats and myself used to have a lot of fun. He and Earl Hines and myself used to meet in Chicago a lot.

But, I enjoyed those movies. I remember doing a show in Cleveland, Ohio with Ethel Waters and Bill "Bojangles" Robinson at one of the RKO houses the, (inaudible) there. I was the band and they was, we was all three of us on the show together. That's when I, Steppin' Fetchit was another one. I did touring with during those years, although
they was a hit andI was going through the theater, but they asked for my band. So, I was with them for awhile.
